name: Portainer
summary: Web page to manage Docker containers, images, volumes and networks.
post_install: Open https://<this NAS>:9443 within 5 minutes and create the administrator account. Portainer locks itself for safety if nobody does; restart the add-on to unlock it. The browser warns about the self-signed certificate. Portainer controls Docker through its socket, which is the same as root on this unit: use a strong password.
